paragraphs.text: Timothar Markov is a vampire noble from Innistrad belonging to the Markov bloodline.

Timothar Markov is a cruel and powerful vampire , one of the finest ever to grace the battlefield. Timothar Markov went through a tough time when Olivia Voldaren announced her wedding to Edgar Markov . It can be hard to hear that your ex is getting married, especially when you're not totally over her. Sure, Timothar only dated Olivia for a couple of hundred years, but it was real to him. He was last heard telling his closest confidants that while he would never actually go to the wedding, it would have been nice to have gotten an invite.
